description:
[Candidates] Mark a suggested duplicate pair (duplicate_id from get_candidate include=duplicates) as not the same person, with an optional note. Nobody is notified, and no tool undoes a dismissal.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

duplicate_id.description: Duplicate pair id (a duplicate pair `id` from get_candidate include=duplicates), from the candidate's duplicates.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

note.description: Why the two records are different people; kept with the decision (at most 2000 characters).

name: dismiss_candidate_duplicate
title: Dismiss a possible duplicate
